content: Apple WWDC23 says synchronous Core ML prediction requires serial model access; asynchronous prediction is thread safe and best effort cancellable, with workload-specific performance and memory costs requiring bounded concurrency. Project inference: retain serial model worker for this reliability milestone, admit bounded work before enqueue and bind immutable frames/timestamps/mappings plus generation; cancellation alone does not establish valid feedback. Source: https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2023/10049/ .
